leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: 10.2.3.1 When a teacher knows more than thirty (30) days in advance of their impending long term absence, the teacher shall notify their principal or immediate supervisor of their expected first day of absence, at least thirty (30) days in advance of that date. 10.2.3.2 When a teacher knows fewer than thirty (30) days in advance of their impending long term absence, the teacher shall notify their principal or supervisor of their expected first day of absence within two (2) days after becoming aware that an impending absence will occur.
